rules.selector: .work-content h1, .work-content h2, .work-content h3, .work-content h4, .work-content h5, .work-content h6

rules.selector: .dark .work-content h1, .dark .work-content h2, .dark .work-content h3, .dark .work-content h4, .dark .work-content h5, .dark .work-content h6

.dark input:-webkit-autofill { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

.dark input:-webkit-autofill:hover { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

.dark input:-webkit-autofill:focus { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

.dark input:-webkit-autofill:active { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

input:-webkit-autofill { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

input:-webkit-autofill:hover { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

input:-webkit-autofill:focus { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }

input:-webkit-autofill:active { -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; background-clip: content-box !important; box-shadow: rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 60px inset !important; }
.input-wrapper::after { content: ""; background-color: var(--color-border); height: 1px; transition: 0.2s ease-in-out; position: absolute; bottom: 0px; left: 0px; right: 0px; }
.shake { backface-visibility: hidden; perspective: 1000px; animation: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) 0s 1 normal both running shake; transform: translateZ(0px); }

#contact-form .submit-button .button-gradient, #careers-form .submit-button .button-gradient { background-image: ; background-position-x: ; background-position-y: ; background-repeat: ; background-attachment: ; background-origin: ; background-clip: ; background-color: ; backface-visibility: hidden; filter: blur(0.8rem); background-size: 300% 100%; border-radius: 9999px; animation: 3s linear 0s infinite normal none running rainbow; transform: translateZ(0px); }
